data.desc: The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world's most trusted source for travel and experiences. Through its leading brands, two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations offerings, and insights from one of the world's largest travel communities, Tripadvisor Group helps millions of travelers discover unforgettable experiences, access trusted travel guidance and content, and plan and book better trips with confidence. Tripadvisor Group consists of the subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP) which together represent a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor and Viator.
